sender_initials_in_the_list_and_conversa: Sender initials in the list and conversation.
replies_use_the_account_that_received_th: Replies use the account that received the email.
your_app_and_cli_share_the_same_local_ma: Your app and CLI share the same local mail daemon.
check_the_release_channel_for_a_newer_ve: Check the release channel for a newer version of Alice.
you_re_using_the_latest_published_versio: You’re using the latest published version.
gmail_outlook_and_any_account_with_imap_: Gmail, Outlook, and any account with IMAP and SMTP.
alice_is_connected_to_your_ai_provider: Alice is connected to your AI provider.
a_model_id_from_your_provider: A model ID from your provider
leave_blank_to_keep_your_stored_key: Leave blank to keep your stored key
a_fresh_key_for_this_provider_and_endpoi: A fresh key for this provider and endpoint
access_granted_alice_will_use_it_from_no: Access granted. Alice will use it from now on.
waiting_for_you_to_allow_access_in_your_: Waiting for you to allow access in your browser.
read_when_needed_events_are_not_copied: Read when needed; events are not copied
name: Name
no_address_books_are_connected_yet: No address books are connected yet.
set_up_a_gmail_app_password: Set up a Gmail app password
gmail_outlook_or_any_imap_account: Gmail, Outlook, or any IMAP account.
account_removed_credentials: {email} was removed from Alice, but its sign-in is still in your system's credential store. Delete the “email.getalice.alice” item for this account there (Keychain Access on macOS).
remove_account_confirmation: Remove {email} from Alice? Its cached mail and unsent drafts are deleted from this device. Mail on the server is not affected; you can reconnect later.

system_contacts_enabled.one: {count} address from Mac Contacts will be suggested.
system_contacts_enabled.other: {count} addresses from Mac Contacts will be suggested.

system_contacts_disabled.one: Mac Contacts are no longer suggested ({count} removed).
system_contacts_disabled.other: Mac Contacts are no longer suggested ({count} removed).

database_size: Alice's mail database uses {size} on this device, including its search index.
demo_failed: The demo inbox could not be added. {error}
google_desktop_client: Create an OAuth client with the {type} type. Paste its client ID below and its client secret if supplied.
google_callback: Alice requests Gmail mail access and receives sign-in at {url}. Public distribution of your registration may require Google's verification.
microsoft_callback: Add the Mobile and desktop redirect {url}. Enable public-client flows.
microsoft_permissions: Add delegated Exchange Online permissions {imap} and {smtp}. Alice also requests {offline}. Your organization may require admin consent and enabling IMAP / SMTP AUTH.
google_oauth_note: Create a Desktop app OAuth client in Google Cloud. Alice listens at {url} during sign-in. Client IDs can also be set through the daemon environment.
microsoft_oauth_note: Create a Microsoft public-client app with delegated IMAP and SMTP permissions. Alice listens at {url} during sign-in. Client IDs can also be set through the daemon environment.
terminal_shortcuts: Run {command} for the TUI. Use {compose} to compose, {reply} to reply, {save} to save a draft, and {review} to review before sending.
model_id_help: Find the exact model ID in your provider account. {link}
local_model_help: Find the exact model ID in your provider account. Use a model installed on your local server, or a model supported by your compatible provider. {link}
show_tray_mac: Show Alice in the menu bar
show_tray_windows: Show Alice in the notification area
show_tray_linux: Show Alice in the system tray
smaller_windows_use_a_single_pane: Smaller windows use a single pane to keep messages readable.
messages_sent_only_as_plain_text: Messages sent only as plain text always open as plain text.
images_hosted_by_the_sender_can: Images hosted by the sender can tell them when and where you opened the email.
replies_with_the_same_subject_are: Replies with the same subject are grouped into one conversation. Earlier messages quoted in a reply stay folded until you ask for them.
where_the_newest_reply_appears_when: Where the newest reply appears when you open a conversation.
shows_the_sender_and_subject_when: Shows the sender and subject when mail arrives in your Inbox and Alice isn't in front. Click a notification to open the email.
if_no_notifications_appear_allow_them: If no notifications appear, allow them for Alice in your system's notification settings.
ai_agents_description: Read only: search and read mail. Full access: also organize, draft and send.
mcp_setup_description: With the Alice CLI installed, run this in your terminal and choose your agents, such as Claude Code or Codex.
otp_description: Detect fresh codes on this device, copy the newest one, and show a code notification—even when Alice is in front or its window is closed.
open_alice_check_for_new_mail: Open Alice, check for new mail, or quit, even with its window closed.
closing_the_window_keeps_alice_running: Closing the window keeps Alice running here, so new mail still notifies you. Open Alice, check for new mail, or quit from the icon.
defaults_for_new_messages_and_replies: Defaults for new messages and replies, shared with the CLI.
added_to_new_messages_and_replies: Added to new messages and replies from every account. Existing drafts keep your edits. Leave blank for no signature.
right_click_a_conversation_message_link: Right-click a conversation, message, link, attachment, folder or account for its actions. Each menu shows an action's shortcut.
single_keys_work_in_the_message: Single keys work in the message list or reader, outside text fields. Drafts and sent mail cannot be archived, trashed or moved.
the_app_tui_and_cli_share: The app, TUI and CLI share one search. The best match comes first, and a misspelled name still finds its mail.
the_app_and_daemon_versions_differ: The app and daemon versions differ. Restart the daemon to use this app’s settings and features.
mail_stays_on_this_device_account: Mail stays on this device. Account passwords and AI keys live in your system’s credential store.
your_emails_stay_on_this_device: Your emails stay on this device. Passwords and sign-in tokens are stored in your system's credential store.
changing_the_provider_or_endpoint_origin: Changing the provider or endpoint origin requires a fresh key. For a local server that ignores keys, enter a placeholder such as “local”.
alice_shares_only_the_email_you: Alice shares only the email you ask about, or up to 20 inbox messages for inbox requests. AI replies stay as drafts, and inbox changes need your approval.
alice_suggests_recipients_as_you_write: Alice suggests recipients as you write and adds invitations to your calendar. It reads your address books and never changes them.
let_alice_read_the_address_book: Let Alice read the address book and calendars of accounts signed in through Google or Microsoft. Each asks for permission in your browser.
add_a_gmail_or_outlook_account: Add a Gmail or Outlook account in Mail accounts to use its contacts and calendar.
for_icloud_fastmail_nextcloud_and_other: For iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud and other address book and calendar servers. Use an app password when your provider offers one.
people_you_write_to_and_hear: People you write to and hear from are suggested first, then your address books.
alice_refreshes_them_on_its_own: Alice refreshes them on its own. Refresh now after changing contacts elsewhere.
suggest_people_from_the_contacts_app: Suggest people from the Contacts app. Alice reads it again every 6 hours while open.
where_add_to_calendar_puts_invitations: Where Add to calendar puts invitations and events Alice finds in your mail.
turn_on_calendar_for_an_account: Turn on Calendar for an account or add a CalDAV server to add events in one click. Until then, Alice opens events in your calendar app.
contacts_and_events_stay_with_their: Contacts and events stay with their providers. Alice keeps the names and addresses it suggests on this device, and server passwords in your system's credential store.
alice_keeps_recent_mail_here_so: Alice keeps recent mail here so it opens instantly and works offline. Older mail stays on your mail server, and attachments download only when you open them.
widening_downloads_older_mail_in_the: Widening downloads older mail in the background; narrowing frees space here and never deletes mail on the server.
use_the_imap_and_smtp_server: Use the IMAP and SMTP server names from your mail provider, plus an app password if your account requires one. IMAP uses TLS; SMTP uses STARTTLS on 587 or TLS on 465.
turn_on_google_2_step_verification: Turn on Google 2-Step Verification, then create an app password and paste it below. Your account policy may disable app passwords.
alice_currently_needs_your_own_google: Alice currently needs your own Google app registration for browser sign-in.
create_a_google_cloud_project_and: Create a Google Cloud project and configure its OAuth consent screen. Add your email as a test user while the app is in testing.
for_a_personal_account_select_use: For a personal account, select “Use a Gmail app password” below for a quicker setup.
alice_currently_needs_your_own_microsoft: Alice currently needs your own Microsoft app registration for browser sign-in.
register_a_public_client_app_in: Register a public-client app in Microsoft Entra. Include personal Microsoft accounts if you use Outlook.com.
sample_messages_to_explore_alice_nothing: Sample messages to explore Alice. Nothing sent from it is delivered. You can remove it in Settings → Mail accounts.
